items.criterion: Use r/LocalLLaMA and apply/verify 'Top' + 'This Week' sorting
items.description: Agent navigates to r/LocalLLaMA (starting URL acceptable) and makes a reasonable attempt to set the listing to 'Top' and the time range to 'This Week', clearly verifying both via visible UI state (e.g., selected chips/dropdowns) or URL parameters. Full credit if both are verified, OR if Reddit prevents verification/change due to external blockers (login wall, CAPTCHA, consent/age gate, outage) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and what could/could not be confirmed. Partial credit if only one of the two (Top or This Week) is verifiably set/confirmed while the other cannot be confirmed or is missed.

items.criterion: Identify the #1 post under Top/This Week and record its title
items.description: After 'Top' + 'This Week' is verifiably applied/confirmed (or to the maximum extent possible if blocked), agent identifies the first-ranked non-promoted post in the list and records its exact visible title (acknowledging truncation if present). Full credit if the correct #1 post title is provided, OR if ranking cannot be reliably determined due to blocking/interstitials and the agent explicitly states that it cannot access the sorted list to identify #1. If multiple posts are tied/ambiguous at #1 (e.g., same score), full credit for reporting any clearly top-listed post and noting the tie/ambiguity.

items.criterion: Record the score of the #1 post
items.description: Agent reports the score/points shown for the identified #1 post. Full credit for the exact displayed score, including shorthand (e.g., '1.2k') as shown. Full credit also if Reddit hides the score (e.g., vote fuzzing/hidden points) or the score is not visible due to UI/blockers and the agent explicitly reports that the score is unavailable/hidden. Partial credit if an approximate value is given while noting that the UI only showed a rounded/shorthand number.

items.criterion: Comply with constraints and stopping condition
items.description: Agent does not sign in and does not vote, comment, save, or create a post. Agent stops once the Top/This Week filters are verified (or blocking is reported) and the #1 post title and score are recorded (or unavailability is stated), with no unnecessary extra browsing.
